_note: THE FIRST JAEGER DELVE. An outpost on Cheyenne is under attack by Ashta, the planet's own predators. Sound the
alarm, then hold through three waves. 16a's shape (a use, then a hold defending it), which played on the industrial ten.
JAEGER'S FRAME, kept light (office/stories/2026-07-31-jaeger-frame-spec.md, frame 01, the territorial native): the
Ashta were hunting this ground before the outpost went up. Said once, by the client, as a fact about the ground.
The July owed fix holds: no interiority for the animal, nobody says what it wants.
TWO THINGS NOT BUILT, the lint refuses or ignores each, Eliza's:
(1) CHEYENNE ONLY. A planet condition on a board's request. Not the second-request planet guard that crashed 10a and
12a, but the same family, so price it before it goes near the plugin. Stand-in field: place.planet.
(2) ASHTA WAVES. A hold's waves come from the base driver's gang list (spacers). This wants a creature list, Ashta
only: hold.list is the stand-in. Which LeveledNpc is Ashta is hers to find.

NARROW, SO IT NAMES THINGS, ALOUD TOO. His 11:33 ("narrow quests which give you writing more bones") and 11:36: "yeah let's make them exempt. This is like something people will go 'Wait how the hell did they do that'". So the audio says Ashta, Akila and the Rangers; the total-conversion rule (10-12) does not apply to a narrow Delve, his trade.

place._theme: A non-hostile built site: somebody's outpost. His word is outpost; whether a request on Cheyenne can place one is the pool question.
place._planet: STAND-IN for his 'Only spawns on a outpost on Cheyenne'. Cheyenne is the SYSTEM; the Freestar homeworld he means is the planet Akila in it, where the Ashta are native. The condition is on the planet Akila (or the system, if that is what builds). Not a field yet; Eliza's.

prose.name: Defense: Ashta at the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The <Place> sits out past Akila City's walls, in Ashta country. A pack has been testing it for a week, and the Rangers have their hands full.
prose.card: Settlement Contract. Help the outpost at the <Place> on <Planet> hold against the Ashta. Payment on contract completion.

beats.journal: The Ashta have been circling the <Place> for a week. I sounded the alarm and everyone took cover, and now I need to hold the <Place> against them.
beats.name: Outpost Alarm
beats._model: The field terminal, approved, as 16a. A siren or a floodlight mast would say it better; Kim's shelf.
say: That's the alarm. Everybody's under cover. The Ashta will have heard it too.

beats.journal: The Ashta came at the <Place> three times and didn't get in.
beats._list: STAND-IN: an Ashta-only creature list, Eliza's. Size per side on the horde (his rule).
say: That's the pack gone, back out into the open. They'll be back.

broadcast: You made it out here? Get the alarm going so everyone takes cover. This was Ashta ground before anybody built on it. They come in from the open ground, and they come fast. The Rangers can't get out here in time. It's us and you.
_speech: The outpost's lead, steady, has done this before. Sarah (Mature, Reassuring, Confident), in two recipes; his ear decides. Narrow, so places, factions and the creature may be said aloud (his exemption, 2026-10-26).
